text: Hi, might be nothing and I'm only his stepdad so maybe I'm missing something his mum would know, but my stepson (5) has a temp of 38.3. He won't put his chin down to his chest, I asked him to look at his tummy and he just wouldn't/couldn't, kept his head straight. Also there are some little purple spots on his arm and chest. I pressed a glass on them like I've seen on posters and they didn't fade. Not sure if that's how you're meant to do it. Should we be doing something?
